desc: Heavy Star: the slow, immovable slammer. Units: seconds, metres, hp. Numbers are the same for every player; only baseline follows the weight class.
name: Heavy Star

look.why: ~30% bigger: reads as the heaviest form from across the map

baseline.why: run-speed bonus by weight class (a light hero keeps the most speed; merge cap +40%)

r.name: Collapse
r.desc: Leap to the marked circle, crash into a crater that pulls foes in, then launches them.
r.why: 0.65s leap with a filling ground marker (7m = the pull's reach), the launch lands 0.4s after the crash

lmb.name: Star Slam
lmb.desc: Every 3rd attack slams the ground where it lands: a small knockback.

rmb.name: Gravity Well
rmb.desc: Your right click also drags nearby foes in and slows them. Recharges 20% faster.

e.name: Quake
e.desc: Your E also quakes the ground around you: damage and a hard shove. Recharges 20% faster.

dash.name: Armoured Charge
dash.desc: Your dash is armoured and shoves everything it runs through.

aug_why: the augment set of this Boki type, identical for every hero: LMB rider, RMB and E add-on effects, the form dash and a modest passive
